The '''Biivren sector''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in<ref name="Expansion" /> [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Biivren sector bordered the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] [[spinward]] and formed a four-way border with the [[Annecy sector/Legends|Annecy]] and [[Couronne sector/Legends|Couronne sectors]] and the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] direction. Together with the Dona Laza sector and the Ghost Nebula, the Biivren sector formed the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border, neighboring the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

The Biivren sector was the site of the [[Biivren system/Legends|Biivren system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Biivren|same name]],<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Werania system/Legends|Werania system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was the origin point of the items known as [[Weranian holocard]]s.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Weranian holocard]]s|system=[[Werania system/Legends|Werania system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
Following the fragmentation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Journal2">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] retreated from Biivren, leaving the [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] to face a shortage of [[Foodstuff/Legends|drinking]] [[Water/Legends|water]] as a result of contamination. A group of [[free-trader]]s subsequently shipped in large amounts of potable water to sell it to the highest bidder.<ref name="Journal2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Biivren sector was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares O-9, O-10, P-9, and P-10.<ref name="Expansion" />
